scope: LITD2 health trauma potions fountains healing and Remanence-linked potion capacity progression
core_rule: HP and trauma are separate systems; only potions cure trauma.

families.name: Fracture
families.primary_effect: strong limb-dependent penalty and aggravation risk

families.name: Plaie profonde
families.primary_effect: effort can reactivate HP loss or bleeding

families.name: Traumatisme crânien
families.primary_effect: perception targeting or information-reading penalty without deliberate input lag

families.name: Côtes fêlées
families.primary_effect: guard effort and physical recovery penalty

families.name: Bras blessé
families.primary_effect: weapon attack or parry penalty depending on affected arm

families.name: Infection
families.primary_effect: secondary persistent degradation until potion treatment

families.name: Brûlure
families.primary_effect: physical sensitivity and recovery penalty until potion treatment

potion.capacity_progression_source: major discoveries and understanding of the Remanence resurrection artifact and its precursor civilization

artifact_discovery_progression.purpose: Tie survival progression to exploration and the central Remanence mystery.
artifact_discovery_progression.major_breakthrough_effect: may permanently increase potion capacity for future runs
artifact_discovery_progression.narrative_requirement: Every capacity increase must reveal or clarify something meaningful about the artifact rather than act as an abstract stat upgrade.

fountain.placement_rule: May move within the hybrid procedural layout but one fountain is guaranteed in each level.

healing_spells_and_skills.rule: Any spell skill regeneration or ordinary heal restores HP only; it never cures persistent trauma.

non_potion_stabilization.rule: Splints bandages immobilization or analgesics may stabilize or reduce aggravation but cannot remove trauma.

examples: 75% HP + sprain -> potion restores HP and cures sprain.
50% HP + sprain -> fountain restores HP but sprain remains.
35% HP + fracture -> healing spell restores HP but fracture remains.
100% HP + active trauma -> potion remains usable and cures trauma.
Campaign begins with potion capacity 3; a major Remanence breakthrough can permanently increase future-run capacity.

body_system_integration.injury_progression: normal impact -> persistent trauma -> severe fracture/lesion -> possible mutilation when attack and target rules permit

locked_rules: HP and trauma are separate systems.
Trauma can occur while HP remains high.
Persistent injury families from LITD1 carry into LITD2.
Potions restore HP and cure all active trauma.
The campaign starts with capacity for three potions per run.
Potion capacity can permanently increase through major Remanence artifact discoveries.
Potion capacity progression is tied to lore and understanding rather than generic currency purchases.
One healing fountain is guaranteed per level.
Healing spells skills regeneration and ordinary HP heals do not cure trauma.
A potion may be used at full HP when trauma is active.
Trauma state feeds gore body-zone and persistent-corpse systems.
